```python
eigh(x) -> tuple
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Hermitian/symmetric eigendecomposition (numpy `linalg.eigh`).

## Parameters

- `x` — `SymbolicTensor` of shape `(..., n, n)` (batched).

## Returns

- `tuple` — `(w, v)` tuple of `SymbolicTensor`s: `w` the ascending REAL eigenvalues `(..., n)`, `v` the eigenvectors `(..., n, n)`. Dtype rule (numpy linalg): int/bool input → float64; float32 stays float32; complex64 → `w` float32 / `v` complex64.

## Raises

- `core.TraceError` — no active trace; concrete `Tensor` operand.

- `core.ShapeError` — rank < 2; statically non-square last two dims.
